title: Bacon Cheeseburger Soup
description: Bacon cheeseburger soup is thick, cheesy, and packed with ground beef and bacon, all swimming in a creamy base made from Campbell's cream of bacon and cheddar cheese soups. It's fast, it's filling, and it tastes like you actually tried.

ingredients.item: Milk or heavy cream (optional, for thinning)

steps: Combine cooked ground beef and bacon in a large pot.
Add Campbell's cream of bacon soup and cheddar cheese soup to the meat mixture.
Stir until well combined and heated through.
If desired, add milk or heavy cream to reach your preferred consistency.
Serve hot, garnished with additional bacon or cheese if desired.
notes:
For a thicker soup, simmer longer to reduce.
